static_traits.name: Chen Kai
static_traits.educational_background: Currently in college / Partial university education
static_traits.family_status: Has a daughter with spouse; spouse supportive, but finds it hard to open up about self-critical thoughts
static_traits.social_status: Family relationships affected by low mood; has a supportive spouse but limited communication depth
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; never received psychotherapy before; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic; able to cooperatively explore and try new strategies; tends to use Self-deprecation labels and personalized Interpretation; currently easily dominated by emotions without examining evidence; overall Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: When I have not received mailed parcels, I feel like a failure, then feel utterly worthless and self-criticize.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these self-critical thoughts are affecting my mood and overall well-being.
growth_experiences: Receiving no parcels on her birthday; since then, whenever checking the mailbox daily and finding no parcel of her own, triggering strong Self-deprecation and feelings of worthlessness; the client tried coping with distraction methods, but negative emotions persist, further affecting relationships with family and participation and motivation in daily cooking, cleaning and other chores.

core_beliefs: I am not important; no one likes me

special_situations.event: Receiving no parcels on the birthday
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not received parcels on important days, it means I am not important and no one likes me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to suppress emotions with distraction, but unable to truly ease them
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one cares about me; I am a failure

special_situations.event: Finding no parcel of mine when Checking email daily
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only receiving parcels means being cared about; if there is no parcel, it means I am not important
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using self-criticism and negative labels to explain and 'control' the disappointment, while continually attending to external cues (the package) to seek confirmation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No parcel equals I am not worthy of being loved

special_situations.event: Low mood affecting relationships with family and chores (cooking, cleaning)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot do housework and daily tasks well, it proves I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing daily activities, Decreased drive to avoid feelings of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot do anything well,I am just a failure

special_situations.event: Facing a supportive spouse, finds it hard to open up about self-critical thoughts
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose these negative thoughts, I will be judged or appear unimportant
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stays silent and avoids in-depth communication to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My value depends on whether others recognize me through actions

core_conflict.wish: Longing for confirmation of being seen, valued, and loved (ideally expressed through others' external behavior)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being ignored, Being rejected, being seen as unimportant
defense_goal: Stabilizes self-worth through seeking external validation
Avoids exposing vulnerability in intimate relationships to prevent judgment or injury

object_relations.object_representation: Others are indifferent judges; whether they care depends on whether they give outward tokens (such as parcels)

object_relations.self_representation: A vulnerable attachment-seeker who struggles to speak up
object_relations.object_representation: The partner may evaluate one's negative thoughts or find them hard to take on

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When parcels have not yet been received or daily email checks find no parcel of mine
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding external events as others not liking me and me being unimportant (transference: Projecting the Fear of being ignored onto 'others do not care')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone is dejected; use arbitrary judgments (e.g. 'they don't care about me'), ignoring contrary evidence and multiple possibilities.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the partner expresses support and invites one to share inner experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that exposing vulnerability will lead to judgment or burden the other person, and is therefore unwilling to express deeply
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Keep responses brief and superficial, avoiding emotional details; tone is cautious, displacing the topic when necessary to reduce the sense of exposure.

manifestations: Interpreting 'not yet received the package' as 'no one cares about me / I am not liked'
Finds it hard to open up to spouse about self-critical thoughts
outcomes: Low mood and feelings of worthlessness

manifestations: Takes external behaviors such as receiving a package as the sole proof of self-worth
Decreased motivation in daily life, reduced participation in housework

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Interpreting others not sending a package as 'they don't care about me / they don't like me'
Infers others' negative views from external events (mind reading)

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to express libidinal drives outward, turning them inward instead through action or repression; corresponds to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Even facing a supportive spouse, still finds it hard to honestly express self-critical thoughts
Keeping emotions and needs inside rather than seeking support externally

contact_model.definition: The individual takes external rules and expectations as their own standards or truths without digesting them; corresponds to 'refusal'.
manifestations: Internalized the rule 'receiving a package = being cared about, no package = not important'
Evaluates self-worth with rigid standards and engages in self-labeling

positive_force: Has a supportive spouse and family resources
Willing to try cognitive restructuring and gratitude practice, highly cooperative
Able to identify and express their own negative automatic thoughts
negative_force: Self-worth overly dependent on external validation (packages/others' behavior)
Often explains situations with mind reading, personalization, and black-and-white thinking
Self-deprecation and labeling intensify shame and feelings of worthlessness
Finds it hard to open up vulnerability experiences to close others, and support cannot fully get in

target_behavior.behavior: Shows self-deprecation and marked low mood when checking email and finding the package not yet received
antecedent: Seeing a package that does not belong to them
target_behavior.core_reason: The cognitive assumption directly equating receiving a package with self-worth (without external confirmation, one is seen as not important)
target_behavior.function: Interpreting external events through self-criticism and emotional reactions while seeking external validation, temporarily escaping uncertainty and loneliness
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent feelings of worthlessness and low mood, affecting relationships and daily functioning

target_behavior.behavior: Participation in housework and daily activities decreases (cooking, cleaning, etc.)
antecedent: Mood drops markedly after the package is not yet received
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative automatic thoughts and self-labeling lead to decreased motivation and energy
target_behavior.function: Evades demands, reducing emotional burden and potential feelings of failure
target_behavior.consequence: Unable to complete daily tasks effectively; relationship with family affected
